items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: the guy would look me up at the hotel and call me up. Say, come on down, Len, the jazz is flowing, you know. So I'd go down.

ctx.x: Yeah. I was staying at a hotel and anytime anybody had any jams, the guy would look me up at the hotel and call me up. Say, come on down, Len, the jazz is flowing, you know. So I'd go down. It'd be nice. I wouldn't
be working you know. Tough times were kind of slim in those days. But we had a great band at that time. Thamon Hayes's band.
